I had an exceptional time foraging in Japan's beautiful forests.
Of course, you can learn more about this experience by purchasing my book.
Now I belong to the Bradford Mushroom Hunters Club.
There are many varieties of mushrooms found in this area.
They are delicious.
If you don't believe me, I brought some of what we found this morning.

我现在属于布拉德福德（Bradford）蘑菇猎人俱乐部。
这个地区发现了很多种类的蘑菇。
它们非常好吃。
如果您不相信我，我带了一些我们今天早上找到的。
